The term describes someone who allocates portions or divides property. Jesus refuses this role not because justice is unimportant but because he came for a greater purpose than settling earthly claims. His mission involves proclaiming the kingdom, not arbitrating property disputes. The refusal leads immediately into the parable of the rich fool, warning against covetousness and storing up earthly treasures."
